title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap More info and paste the request there, for a deep dive.

items.headline_md: **Iran**'s supreme leader orders a "maximum" response to any **US** attack
items.summary_md: Mojtaba Khamenei told his top commanders a renewed US-Israeli attack must be met without geographical limits, as Qatari mediators held 12+ hours of talks in Tehran to restart US-Iran negotiations before the midterms.

items.headline_md: Tankers explode in the **Strait of Hormuz**
items.summary_md: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said three tankers caught fire and exploded on "unauthorised" routes, a day after the US military said it had cleared the strait's main shipping lane.

items.headline_md: High-speed train collision in **Spain** kills 69
items.summary_md: Two high-speed trains collided near Urda, and families are still waiting for the dead to be identified.

items.headline_md: **US midterms** enter the final weekend with a record ~50M early votes
items.summary_md: The DOJ also stepped up a criminal probe tied to the Alaska Senate race ahead of Tuesday's vote.

items.headline_md: **Pope Leo XIV** becomes the first pope to vote in a US election
items.summary_md: The Vatican confirmed he voted by mail in Illinois's midterms.

items.headline_md: Italian army **Chinook** crash in **Bosnia** kills four troops
items.summary_md: Eleven more were injured during an EUFOR Althea mission in the Brcko district.

items.headline_md: **Alphabet** loses over $500B in market value as AI search dents ad sales
items.summary_md: Shares fell nearly 13% to a six-month low even as quarterly revenue grew 25% to $127.6B; net profit fell 25% and free cash flow turned negative on AI spending.

items.headline_md: **Fitch** cuts **France**'s debt outlook to negative
items.summary_md: It kept France's A+ rating after GDP unexpectedly shrank 0.1% in Q3, while the wider eurozone grew 0.4%.

items.headline_md: **Bank of Japan** holds at 1.25% as inflation finally hits its 2% goal
items.summary_md: It's the first time inflation has reached the target since the BoJ adopted it more than 13 years ago.

items.headline_md: **Cleveland-Cliffs** may recall 175 laid-off **Stelco** workers by Christmas
items.summary_md: CEO Lourenco Goncalves also cut planned layoffs from up to 500 to 175, depending on Canadian steel demand.

items.headline_md: More than 80% of **Roblox**'s top games now use AI
items.summary_md: PocketGamer.biz reports the figure alongside Playgama's tracking of which AI tools developers prefer, a useful signal for small mobile studios.

items.headline_md: **Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold** slips to Feb. 23, 2027
items.summary_md: Square Enix delayed the expansion about four weeks and revealed its new Zephyr crossbow-and-bird job; preorders open Nov. 4.

items.headline_md: Nintendo cancels **Kirby Air Riders**' Halloween event over freezing
items.summary_md: The Trick or Treat event kept freezing the screen, and Nintendo says it'll rerun it later with no date yet.

items.headline_md: Update: **Modern Warfare 4** will drop its Itaewon crush footage on Nov. 12
items.summary_md: Activision apologized to the victims' families and will remove the clip in the next update.

items.headline_md: **Skyblivion** fan remake faces legal threats from a former volunteer
items.summary_md: The team rebuilt the disputed code from scratch for a clean break and says it still plans to release.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: **Switch 2 first today.** Wii U general lifter watch: still no public repo or release from the r/decomps poster (web search found only the separate nWiiURecomp and CafeRecomp projects). Reddit's r/decomps feed returned nothing to a direct request, so it wasn't read directly.

items.headline_md: Update: **Eglantine**, an open-source **Switch 2** emulator fork, boots **Mario Kart World**, **DK Bananza** and **Splatoon Raiders**
items.summary_md: Built on Eden-NX2, it has 64 automated Windows and Linux builds plus FSR 3 frame generation, but it's still an experimental prototype with missing geometry and heavy stutter.

items.headline_md: **Zone of the Enders** hits 1.0 as a fully playable native PC recomp via **PS2Recomp**
items.summary_md: ZOE-Recompiled runs intro to ending at a stable 60 fps and needs the US disc; **Rogue Galaxy**, **Shadow of the Colossus** and **Twisted Metal: Black** also got PS2Recomp builds.

items.headline_md: **any3ds**, a new **3DS** static recompiler, gets **Pokémon X** through its first towns
items.summary_md: It translates ARM code into C ahead of time; there's no sound and no ready-made release yet.

items.headline_md: Recomp release flood: **ICO**, **King Kong**, **MediEvil**, **Perfect Dark Zero** and dozens more updated Oct. 31–Nov. 1
items.summary_md: Recomp Software's weekly tracker lists new builds across N64, PS1, PS2 and Xbox 360 ports.

items.headline_md: Update: **You Can See Everything** wins Halloween weekend (Oct. 30–Nov. 1) with ~$11M
items.summary_md: The A24 Elizabeth Holmes doc climbed to No. 1 in its third weekend for about $63M domestic; the top 10 totaled roughly $45.9M.

items.headline_md: **Clayface** drops ~57% to ~$10.4M; **Wildwood** holds at ~$7.5M
items.summary_md: Clayface's total reached about $44M in week two, and Wildwood fell only about 40%.

items.headline_md: New releases open soft: **BTS World Tour Arirang** ~$3M, **The Only Living Pickpocket in New York** ~$2M
items.summary_md: Pickpocket, Noah Segan's crime thriller with John Turturro, has a 97 on Rotten Tomatoes.

items.headline_md: Next weekend (Nov. 6): **Godzilla Minus Zero** tracks ~$29M, **The Cat in the Hat** ~$21M
items.summary_md: **Ramayana** is forecast around $13M among at least five new wide releases.

items.headline_md: Buzz check: can **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** return the franchise to $100M+ openings?
items.summary_md: Box Office Theory's latest five-week forecast also gives early expectations for **Violent Night 2**.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI** pares its raise to up to $20B at a $1.25T valuation
items.summary_md: It had targeted about $30B; the round is still open and terms could change, per CNBC and the FT.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic**'s IPO prospectus shows an $80B first-half loss
items.summary_md: The filing also lists hundreds of billions in compute commitments and more than 90 pages of risk factors.

items.headline_md: **Nvidia** weighs backing debt for **Nscale**'s Anthropic data center
items.summary_md: Anthropic has a $44.6B contract for the first 460-megawatt building in West Virginia.

items.headline_md: A **Claude Sonnet 5** agent performed gene-therapy surgery on a mouse, then halted on a calibration error
items.summary_md: Exin Therapeutics' results aren't peer-reviewed yet.

items.headline_md: **Wiz** says at least nine AI developer platforms were breached in October
items.summary_md: Separate research found command-execution flaws in the built-in browsers of five AI coding tools.

items.headline_md: **Google** opens a Connected Apps preview inside **AI Mode** and **Gemini**
items.summary_md: Approved apps like Instacart, Canva and YouTube Music can run inside Google's AI surfaces via MCP, a new distribution channel for apps.

items.headline_md: **South Korea** fines **Google** and **Apple** $47.6M over app payments
items.summary_md: Both must allow links to outside payment options and revise their app review procedures.

items.headline_md: **Apple** CEO **John Ternus** says Apple won't ship "AI for AI's sake"
items.summary_md: He said Apple will use AI but only where it serves the product.

items.headline_md: Judge lets **NAACP** pollution suit against **xAI**'s Memphis data center proceed
items.summary_md: The Clean Air Act case targets unpermitted gas turbines.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: US markets are closed for the weekend, and Friday's index close ran in yesterday's brief; no futures quotes were available at fetch time.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin** near $77,800, up about 0.5% (quoted Nov. 1, fetched 5:10 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: It's been trading in a roughly $77,400 to $78,200 range today.

items.headline_md: **Binance** says 90% of the $6.3B hack losses are covered
items.summary_md: Withdrawals are set to resume Sunday, Nov. 1, after the record crypto theft.

items.headline_md: Friday's chip rout went deep: **AMD** −10.9%, **Dell** −10.8%, chip index −7.2%
items.summary_md: The semiconductor index's October losses topped 15%, and the Nasdaq sits 7.8% below its Oct. 6 record (Friday close, 1 PM AZ).

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: high near 72, low around 58; heavy rain and storms; ⚠️ Flood Watch
items.summary_md: Near-certain showers and thunderstorms today with 1 to 2 inches of new rain possible, plus another quarter to half inch tonight; the Flood Watch runs until 5 AM AZ Monday.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: high near 56, low around 39; fog and storms; ⚠️ Flood Watch, Wind Advisory, Flood Advisory
items.summary_md: A 100% chance of showers and storms with south winds 25 to 30 mph gusting to 48; the Wind Advisory runs to 11 PM AZ and the Flood Watch to 5 AM AZ Monday (no rain totals given).

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: high near 59, low around 40; storms all day; ⚠️ Flood Watch, Wind Advisory
items.summary_md: A 100% chance of showers and storms with gusts to 48 mph; the Wind Advisory runs to 11 PM AZ and the Flood Watch to 5 AM AZ Monday (no rain totals given).

items.headline_md: Movie production costs are down 16.2% while everything else got pricier
items.summary_md: David A. Gross digs into The Numbers' data showing wide-release budgets fell even amid inflation, and what that means for studios and crews.
